evidence.V1: Silhouette reads as a toadstool from front, 3/4 and side outline: broad dome cap on a tall stem plus a child mushroom; top view is just a spotted red disc but that is expected for a cap.
evidence.V2: Big cap / medium stem / small spots + child mushroom exist, but the small level is thin: only 4-5 spots, no visible gills or ring/skirt under the cap ('gills' close-up shows only the cap side), so mid detail is sparse.
evidence.V3: Cap-to-stem ratio is pleasantly chunky, but the main stem is a near-straight cylinder with a small foot flare and the child mushroom is a scaled copy; reads partly stylised, partly primitive.
evidence.V4: Organic fused shells are smooth, but cap rim outline and stem foot flare show visible polygon steps in the base close-up; spots have soft rounded edges; treatment is serviceable but uneven.
evidence.V5: No pinches, seams or z-fighting; minor faceting on the cap rim silhouette and foot flare in the base close-up, and a slight flat-shaded band at the cap underside edge.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one cap hue in two values (dark top, lighter rim band) plus cream stem/spots; colourways (teal, ember) swap cleanly.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material, smooth shading, cream #F3E3BE-like stem/spots and a single cap hue in 2 values; fits wave-2 nature kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, SmoothPlastic, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Visible polygon stepping on cap rim outline and stem foot flare in base close-up
top_fixes: Add an underside gill/ring detail (or skirt on the stem) so the medium/small tier is richer
Add a gentle bend/taper to the main stem and vary the child mushroom's proportions instead of a scaled copy
Raise segment count on the cap rim and foot flare (budget allows ~400 more tris) to remove silhouette stepping
Add 2-4 more spots of varied size to the cap
